**Verdict: PASS** for DG0 round 26 (task T-DG0-REV-QA-R26). I raised no new findings, and none of my earlier findings are open.

The frozen candidate checked out. The ID recomputes to `sha256:7ac71190…` from `7edacdc`, the clone is complete (not shallow), and HEAD `2f480e4` adds only freeze metadata. The only candidate changes since round 25 are in `rules.mjs`, `validator.test.mjs` and `decisions.md`.

| # | Check | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Source extraction; gate self-tests 63/63 (includes the new D-042 test); agent tests 39/39 (node) and 22/22 (python); `--register`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile`; candidate ID | PASS |
| 2 | Dry-run gate on the full history (fresh `--no-local` clone, 230 commits) | PASS: 0 errors in the PRUNED, RECORD-LESS and DROPPED buckets, and 0 closure-anchor errors, including the new "is not present" form. The remaining errors are either the round not being finished yet or one artefact of my test script. |
| 3 | `prefreeze.sh DG0` in a fresh `--no-local` clone | 11/11 PASS |
| 4 | New round-26 negative suite (7 tests, all new versus `tools/gates/tests/`) | 7/7 PASS on the candidate |
| 5 | The same suite on the round-25 candidate (before the fix) | Several of the new cases are accepted there, which shows the gap was real |
| 6 | Census of all 115 closed findings | Each fix commit is contained in all three commits it is checked against, and none of the verifying rounds has a missing freeze commit |
| 7 | Every `fix_revision` in `findings.json` | All are full 40-hex, present, and ancestors of HEAD and of the gate commit |
| 8 | Requirement register (Python script plus my round-1 node script) | 0 errors: 412 rows, and the 19 IMPLEMENTED rows are exactly the 19 assigned DG0 requirements |
| 9 | Agent setup | PASS: the ten agents loaded in separate runs with distinct sessions, and all 99 recorded runs asked for `claude-opus-5-5` |
| 10 | Live write-guard probe | All six out-of-scope writes were blocked (`docs/source/QA-PROBE.txt` included), three through the Write tool and three through the shell |
| 11 | Feasibility | All 28 scenarios A01–A28 have a test level and a stage |

**The D-042 fix (F-DG0-169):**
- **Round-25 case now rejected.** The case is a round whose freeze commit is claimed but missing, with a fix committed after that freeze. Both the candidate-scope and the non-candidate version are now rejected, with the F-DG0-169 error as the only error, and the validator command-line tool exits 1. On the round-25 candidate both were accepted.
- **Every such closure is rejected.** A closure verified in a round whose freeze commit is missing is rejected even when its fix is present in every commit it is checked against.
- **Non-commit objects are rejected too.** A round whose freeze commit is a tree or blob that exists in the repository is rejected as well.
- **Only closures are affected.** A round with a missing freeze commit that closes no finding is still tolerated, as D-042 says.
- **Standing controls still hold:**
  - a fix committed after a genuine round's freeze is rejected;
  - an all-zero or missing `fix_revision` is rejected;
  - a missing or `unknown` run start commit is rejected;
  - a later round cannot lower `severity` or `mandatory_violation` (F-DG0-165);
  - a shallow clone is refused.

**Things to know:**
- **Older suites need updating.** Two cases in my round-25 and round-24 suites (QA25-N2, QA24-N2) now fail. They expected exactly one error, and D-042 adds a second one, so the validator is stricter, not looser. The round-25 probe QA25-P1 flipped from accepted to rejected. Details are in `10c-regression-delta.log`.
- **My own test bug.** On the first run, test QA26-N4 failed because of a mistake in my test setup, not in the product. I fixed the test only; the failing run is kept as `13a-qa26-first-run-harness-bug.log`.
- **Wrong round number in the assignment.** `review-common.md` says "Review round: 23"; I used round 26, as the paths and task ID say.
- **F-DG0-169 is still waiting to be closed.** It belongs to code-security, so I wrote no verifications sidecar. It stays FIXED_PENDING_VERIFICATION until code-security closes it.
- **Other reviewers' records.** The domain and code-security run evidence was auto-committed during my run (metadata only; the candidate ID is unchanged). I did not read their records.

Disposable clones were removed. My record is `docs/delivery/reviews/DG0/round-26/qa-verifier.json` (it validates against the schema, and all 43 evidence entries exist), with the narrative `qa-verifier.md` next to it. Logs are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/round-26/`, and the new suite is `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/dg0-gate-negative-r26.test.mjs`.
